observation.depicts: A mossy old-growth forest composite with a semi-transparent figure with a shoulder bag standing on a cobblestone path, a quote text box top left, a utility pole at right and a small "Parker Jackim Period 2" label bottom right.
observation.text_readable: Readable: "Standing on the bare ground, — my head bathed by the blithe air...", "I become a transparent eye-ball; I am nothing; I see all". "Parker Jackim Period 2" at bottom right is small but readable at full size.
observation.composition: Figure sits right of centre; quote box in top-left corner; utility pole and yellow-marked kerb crowd right edge; dense foliage fills the frame with no empty margins.
observation.tone_and_contrast: Saturated greens, bright highlights in the canopy, darker lower left; figure is green-tinted and blends into moss, separation is low.
observation.sharpness_and_artifacts: Sharp moss and cobble detail; blurred translucent panel behind quote text; figure has ghosted overlay look; small caption plate baked into corner; no watermark.
observation.scan_first_read: A green mossy forest with a ghostly figure and a quote; reads as atmospheric, text block hard to skip.

legend.0: Far too few pixels or very soft: detail is mushy or blocky even at the file's native size
legend.1: Small or soft: visible softness or coarse pixels at native size; would look weak enlarged or on high-density screens
legend.2: Adequate: acceptable at native size but with little headroom for enlargement
legend.3: Good: sharp at native size with reasonable headroom
legend.4: Excellent: crisp with ample pixels; holds up when enlarged

legend.2: The main text is readable but secondary text is hard to read
legend.3: All meaningful text is readable with slight effort
legend.4: All text is crisp and effortless to read

legend.2: The subject is identifiable with some effort
